notes: Patches now available on 038906012FA and 038906012FK files: multimap switch (new - the added map slots are filled from your file's own manual block), launch control, lope idle, PTO idle, IO outputs / IO remap, shift light, ASV delete, DTC off and checksum disable. The N75 family (inversion, deep idle, fast warmup) works on FA; on FK those maps have a different shape so they stay off. Flash immo-off stays FD-only - its location on FA/FK is unknown. EEPROM immo-off already worked on every ECU. Nothing changed for 038906012FD files.
